text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ――To my retainer, I make this solemn vow.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I swear upon our ancestors:
I shall bring glory to our house without fail.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: The glory earned here will one day grace the illustrious 'Kingdom of Roses.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she headed toward the paddock with majestic poise,
I saw her off with a deep bow.
